title: Telemetry Docs — Startup Failure
description: A telemetry-docs pod remains pending while a container waits to start.
investigation_focus: Inspect pod and container state alongside Kubernetes events
Compare current observations with historical and domain context
Validate proposed explanations against the available evidence

title: Checkout and Payment — Application Failure
description: Checkout PlaceOrder and payment Charge operations show errors during the incident window.
investigation_focus: Compare operation metrics, log patterns, and trace error summaries
Inspect checkout-to-payment relationships without assuming causation
Check Kubernetes state and validate competing explanations

title: Ad Service — High CPU
description: The ad service shows a substantial CPU increase in the incident window.
investigation_focus: Compare CPU measurements across baseline and incident windows
Inspect log patterns, trace summaries, and Kubernetes state
Validate explanations without treating a symptom as a proven cause

title: Cart Failure
description: Cart EmptyCart calls failed to reach their storage path while the Cart workload remained Running/Ready; other sampled Valkey activity was also observed.
symptoms: Redis connection error on Cart EmptyCart
investigation_focus: Distinguish the failing EmptyCart path from other observed Cart storage activity
Relate Cart-side failure evidence to the Checkout client trace without assuming all Cart calls failed
Treat the untimed Running/Ready pod snapshot as context rather than a timeline

title: Checkout → Payment · Dependency Unavailable
description: Checkout records UNAVAILABLE responses on outbound Payment Charge requests, with errors observed in related Checkout operations.
investigation_focus: Inspect the outbound Checkout-to-Payment Charge status and related Checkout operation errors
Compare client-side and server-side observations without assuming unobserved Payment behavior
Use Kubernetes state as context and preserve the gaps in service-side evidence

title: Downstream Latency
description: Checkout-to-Shipping and Shipping /ship-order traces show longer durations during the incident window, while /get-quote remains near baseline. Experimental: a prior live analysis failed Validator reference-integrity checks; failures remain visible and analyses are not automatically retried.
investigation_focus: Compare Shipping operation latency with the caller-side Checkout-to-Shipping edge
Keep the near-baseline /get-quote operation as counterevidence to a broad Shipping slowdown
Separate an observed latency increase from a proven downstream causal bottleneck

title: Memory Leak
description: Email memory measurements rise and available memory falls over the three-minute incident capture; send_email traces also take longer without reported operation errors.
symptoms: Resident and usage memory measurements increased
send_email mean latency increased without recorded operation errors
investigation_focus: Assess whether memory growth during the short capture supports resource-pressure concerns
Compare memory movement with the send_email latency increase and zero reported trace errors
Avoid treating a three-minute simulation as proof of a persistent memory leak

title: Messaging Failure
description: A prepared messaging exercise records a queue-overload simulation and a consumer-side delay alongside producer and consumer telemetry.
symptoms: Measured consumer lag remains at zero
investigation_focus: Compare the captured queue-overload and consumer-delay records with producer and consumer signals
Account for the zero measured consumer-lag values rather than assuming a lag spike
Separate the intended simulation from what the telemetry independently establishes

title: Crash Loop Backoff
description: The telemetry-docs container terminated with exit code 42 and Kubernetes reported BackOff restarts; the pod phase still reads Running while readiness is false. Experimental: a prior live run produced speculative qualified hypotheses that did not usefully explain the injected exit-42 fault.
symptoms: Container readiness false after repeated restarts
investigation_focus: Relate the container termination and restart metric to the Kubernetes BackOff event
Distinguish the pod-level Running phase from the terminated, not-ready container state
State the limits of a Kubernetes-only capture without logs or traces
